units: <cite ref="Berakhot 46a:6">Ber. 46ᵃ</cite> <he>מע׳ ועד עולם</he> from now and forever. Tanḥ.
Mishp. 18 וע׳ באתי and now I have come again; a. fr. [In Talm. mostly עכשיו.]—As a dialectic term: מֵעַ׳ from now, i.e. as a consequence; if this were so, then.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 1:6:3">Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מע׳ חטין אל ימכור וכ׳</he> according to this he ought not to sell him wheat &c.; a. fr.—Mostly: <he>אֶלָּא מע׳</he>.

Succ. 2ᵃ א׳ מ׳ העושה סוכתו וכ׳ but according to this, if a man put up his Succah in Ashteroth Karnayim (v. עַשְׁתָּרוֹת), would you also say that it is no legitimate Succah? B. Kam. 17ᵇ; a. fr.—אֱמוֹר מע׳ say from now, i.e. learn from this, therefore.
<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 5:2">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. V, 2</cite>.
